name: Abyss: The Last Night of the Titania
summary: You wake in Cabin 47, nine decks below the boat deck of a sinking liner. Abyss is a first-person horror escape game: every deck floods on its own clock and has its own monster, and the Captain follows you all the way up. Get caught and you start again from the bottom.
